Updates cost limits, improves code style, and fixes context handling for iOS in chat routes. Also includes minor bug fixes and code style improvements across several files.

commits.body: Adds HTTP status code tracking and response body buffering to SSEClient for better error reporting on non-2xx responses. Enhances event packet splitting to support both LF and CRLF delimiters, and trims whitespace from event lines for more robust parsing.

commits.body: Commented out the pruning of agents during sync to prevent accidental deletion of local chat history, as agent deletion cascades to sessions and messages. Added a note explaining the rationale for this change.

commits.body: Updated the memory management section to clarify AutoMem/AutoHub behavior, provide more precise recall and storage instructions, and emphasize correct tagging practices. commits.headline: Fix display cache not refreshing after streaming completes
commits.body:
The cachedDisplayData was only refreshed when messages.count changed via
.onChange(of: messages.count), but streaming updates message content
without changing the count. This caused text responses to not appear
after streaming even though the content was saved to Core Data.

commits.headline: Add support for v3 tool events and text reset in chat
commits.body: Introduces parsing for v3 normalized 'tool_use' and 'tool_result' events in HubAPIService, enabling flat structure handling. Adds 'onTextReset' callback to handle full text replacement after tool execution, updating OrchestratorChatView to use this callback for accurate assistant content updates.

Refactors chat.js to emit normalized 'tool_use' and 'tool_result' events with stable indices, supporting the new protocol for richer, structured SSE streaming.
